name: MTAC 243 102 MAX (MTAC, 102 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".45". No method mark: method not stated. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .243, Grains 102, Minimum Required Twist *1-7", Part Number MTAC 243 102 MAX, G1 BC .45, OAL 1.274", Bullet Projection .835"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .835".
